title: An n-vector annihilating every w^♭∧α with w ⊥ V only sees the restriction of covectors to V
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d+1, ζ ∈ Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) and V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace with orthogonal projection p_V (V.starProjection). Assume ζ(γ) = 0 whenever w ∈ V^⊥, α is a d-covector and γ is an n-covector with γ(u_0, …, u_d) = Σ_{i=0}^{d}(−1)^i⟨w, u_i⟩α(u_0, …, û_i, …, u_d) for all u (û_i omitted). Then ζ(β) = ζ(β∘p_V) for every n-covector β, where (β∘p_V)(u_0, …, u_d) := β(p_Vu_0, …, p_Vu_d) (β.compContinuousLinearMap p_V).
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P (d + 1)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ w ∈ Vᗮ, ∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) d) (γ : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1)), (∀ u : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P, γ u = ∑ i : Fin (d + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * (inner ℝ w (u i) * α (i.removeNth u))) → ζ γ = 0) → ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), ζ β = ζ (β.compContinuousLinearMap V.starProjection)
